test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There are seven row houses, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, in a campus. They are not located in alphabetical sequence. P is not at any end. R is to the immediate right of P. S is third from the left. O is at the left end, M is second from the right. O is not with N. Where is Q located?
solution:
Seven houses: M, N, O, P, Q, R, S

1) S is third from the left.

2) O is at the left end.

3) M is second from the right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52e75f414b27d8f44192cf2c3a3d5d93fecbba27cc4dfd2edf8530d8e66a101c.png] 

4) P is not at any end and R is to the immediate right of P.
